records.text: People at the Constanța base did not trust the Ohio-based head of United Hands Romania because they had no connection to her, and Erika Kirk used a different shipping company rather than the military's.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: the woman that is the boots on the ground in Romania for United Hands Romania Association—the head of that—lives in Ohio. ... the people who are there don't trust her because they don't have a connection to her. ... I use a different shipping company to get there. I never use the military's.

verification.notes: The source appearance is Erika Kirk's own recorded account. She says the replacement personnel at the Constanta base did not trust the Ohio-based United Hands leader because they lacked a relationship with her, and that she used a different shipping company rather than military shipping. This verifies the attributed statement, not the personnel's underlying reasons independently.
